title: Decide whether CREN will supply its own documentary photos
question: Will you take or commission documentary photos for held stories, starting with the WWCD building at 1036 S. Front St. before it is demolished: yes or no?
cost_of_delay: Three verified stories are held only for images (newsroom briefs 2026-09-24 to 2026-09-26); the WWCD photo window closes at demolition.
default_if_unanswered: No: the newsroom keeps holding image-blocked stories under current policy.
note: First raised in directives/2026-09-24-cmo.md. Queued behind the three-item owner cap.
